title: WaterColor "Beachside #17" 1848 E. Co. Hwy 30A
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 10 wristbands.- Gulf-front - Steps away from the beach club- Dune walkover is near your front door- Balcony amazing views of the emerald waters- Access to separate private condo pool- Open parking directly in front of the building under the trellis- 4 Adult Bikes Provided (4 Max Per HOA)- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: This bright and airy non-smoking gulf front townhome is located on the 3rd and 4th floors and is a perfect vacation retreat! Beautiful wood floors accent the whole living area, including the living room, dining, and kitchen areas, which are all located on the first level. There is ample seating in the richly appointed living room, a television with DVD, and large French doors that lead onto a furnished porch with wonderful views of the Gulf and community pool. The large kitchen features granite countertops and a breakfast bar that seats 3. The dining area is adjacent to the kitchen and seats 8 comfortably. Two spacious bedrooms are located on the first level. The primary features a king-size bed, a television, and fabulous views of the Gulf and pool. The private bath offers a shower and a single vanity. The second bedroom has a queen-sized bed, television, and a private bath with a single vanity and shower. On the upper level are 2 bedrooms. The first bedroom, a second master, is furnished with a king-size bed, a television, and French doors that brighten the room and lead out to a balcony that offers stunning views of the emerald green Gulf. The primary also has a private bath with double vanity, a shower, and a separate jetted tub. The second bedroom on this floor has a bunk bed, a built-in twin size bed, and an additional twin-size day bed with a trundle. There is also a private bath with a single vanity and shower.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS:THIRD FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom One: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only - Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only FOURTH FLOOR:- Second Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub - Bunk Room: Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed, Twin Bed and Twin Bed with Trundle, Private Bathroom with Shower Only Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments, and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.Disclaimer: All Low-Speed Vehicle rentals in WaterColor must be arranged through The Electric Cart Company. Only one cart is allowed per home, and rentals are on a first-come, first-served basis, with a limit of 60 vehicles allowed in the community at any time. Additionally, WaterColor condominium buildings do not have exterior outlets for charging Low-Speed Vehicles/Low-Speed Vehicles (LSVs). 360 Blue does not provide extension cords for charging. Please discuss charging needs directly with your rental company.
